insights.content: DTC #1 is 2-1 in 35B (W4 was a bye). Karen Kiyono (3.45→3.46) and Claudia Hernandez (3.44→3.46) are the D1 pair. Stacie Corelle (1-1) handles S1. The roster has depth but lacks a dominant singles weapon like Arika Carrier (TPC, 3.60→3.74) or Melanie Isbell (Dragonridge, 3-0).

The 4-1 loss to Red Rock CC #2 in W3 exposed DTC #1's ceiling. Red Rock #2 (4-0) is the class of 35B with Mary Lind (3.64, 4-0 across all lines). DTC #1 will face them again — a different gameplan is needed.

Most overrated dynamics in 3.5: Kelly Nguyen (DTC #3, 3.34→3.05, -0.29), Joann Komanowski (LTF, 3.54→3.29, -0.25), Melissa Hicks (Desert Palm cross-list, 3.03→2.87, -0.16), Lisa Gobel (Spanish Trail #2, 3.54→3.28, -0.26).

Most underrated in 3.5: Yan Uyeno (Red Rock #1, 3.55→3.83, +0.28), Tina Nathalia (Summerlin cross-list, 3.12→3.28, +0.16), Shi Oskooi (DTC #1 cross-list, 2.76→2.91, +0.15), Arika Carrier (TPC, 3.60→3.74, +0.14).

Biggest 35B threats: Arika Carrier (TPC, 3-0 at D1, 3.74 new rating), Mary Lind (Red Rock #2, 4-0), Melanie Isbell (Dragonridge, 3-0 at S1/S2). Biggest 35A threats: Yan Uyeno (Red Rock #1, 3.83, 4-0), Rika Cook (Summerlin, 3.54→3.81, 3-1).

35A is led by Summerlin (3-1) and DTC #2 (3-1). Red Rock CC #1 is 1-3 but Yan Uyeno (3.55→3.83, 4-0) is the division's biggest riser. Spanish Trail #2 at 1-3 relies on cross-listed 3.0 players who are overmatched.

sections.title: 04/18 — next match preview: DTC #1 vs DTC #3

insights.content: DTC #1 (2-1) faces DTC #3 (0-4). DTC #3 is the weakest team in 35B — their roster is mostly cross-listed 3.0 players. This should be a comfortable win.
DTC #3's D1 options are all losing: Kelly Nguyen (3.34→3.05, 0-3), LaCheyva Edmonis (0-3), Alexandria Chang (0-1). DTC #1's Karen Kiyono + Claudia Hernandez should be heavily favored.
Deploy Shi Oskooi at S2 if roster allows — her 3.0 form (4-0, 2.76→3.03) translates well. She won her only 3.5 S2 match. This is an opportunity to build her 3.5 record.
DTC #1 should win 4-1 or 5-0. Target 5-0 for game differential in standings tiebreakers.
vs DRAGONRIDGE CC (3-1). Real test. Melanie Isbell (3-0 at S1/S2) is a singles threat. Lorraine Yarde (2-0) at D1 is solid. Expect a 3-2 either way.
vs SPANISH TRAIL #1 (2-2). Sara Sager (3-1) is reliable but beatable. Chandra VanPaepeghem (3-0) is their danger player. DTC #1 should win 3-2.
vs RED ROCK CC #2 (4-0). Toughest match on the schedule. Mary Lind (3.64, 4-0) leads a deep roster. Probable loss unless DTC #1 brings their best lineup.
vs SPANISH TRAIL #1 again. By this point lineup tendencies will be clear.
DTC #1 needs 3-2 or better over remaining 5 matches. Key: beat DTC #3 and Spanish Trail (expected), split Dragonridge, steal one from Red Rock #2.
